$comment: Owned by @golemui/gui-schemas (libs/gui/schemas/src/lib/). Handwritten, edit directly. Each implementation publishes its own validators schema exposing the #/$defs/validator entry pointer.
title: GolemUI Validator Definitions

required.description: Makes the field mandatory - validation fails if the value is empty or absent

minLength.description: Minimum number of characters the string must contain

maxLength.description: Maximum number of characters the string may contain

pattern.description: A regular expression pattern the value must match

format.description: A named format the string must conform to (e.g. `email`, `url`, `date`, `uuid`)

const.description: The string must equal exactly this value

enum.description: The string must be one of these allowed values

messages.description: Custom error messages that override the default text for each constraint violation

invalid.description: Shown when the value fails general type validation

required.description: Shown when a required field is empty

minLength.description: Shown when the value is shorter than `minLength`

maxLength.description: Shown when the value is longer than `maxLength`

pattern.description: Shown when the value does not match the `pattern` regex

format.description: Shown when the value does not conform to the specified `format`

enum.description: Shown when the value is not in the `enum` list

const.description: Shown when the value does not equal `const`

required.description: Makes the field mandatory - validation fails if the value is absent

minimum.description: The value must be greater than or equal to this number (inclusive)

maximum.description: The value must be less than or equal to this number (inclusive)

exclusiveMinimum.description: The value must be strictly greater than this number (exclusive)

exclusiveMaximum.description: The value must be strictly less than this number (exclusive)

multipleOf.description: The value must be a multiple of this number

const.description: The value must equal exactly this number

enum.description: The value must be one of these allowed numbers

messages.description: Custom error messages that override the default text for each constraint violation

invalid.description: Shown when the value fails general type validation

minimum.description: Shown when the value is below `minimum`

exclusiveMinimum.description: Shown when the value is not strictly above `exclusiveMinimum`

exclusiveMaximum.description: Shown when the value is not strictly below `exclusiveMaximum`

multipleOf.description: Shown when the value is not a multiple of `multipleOf`

enum.description: Shown when the value is not in the `enum` list

const.description: Shown when the value does not equal `const`

required.description: Makes the field mandatory - validation fails if the value is absent or false (e.g. an unchecked required checkbox)

const.description: The value must equal exactly this boolean (e.g. `true` to require acceptance)

messages.description: Custom error messages that override the default text for each constraint violation

invalid.description: Shown when the value fails general type validation

const.description: Shown when the value does not equal `const`

required.description: Makes the field mandatory - validation fails if the array is empty or absent

minItems.description: The array must contain at least this many items

maxItems.description: The array must contain no more than this many items

uniqueItems.description: When true, all items in the array must be distinct values

messages.description: Custom error messages that override the default text for each constraint violation

invalid.description: Shown when the value fails general type validation

required.description: Shown when a required array is empty or absent

minItems.description: Shown when the array has fewer items than `minItems`

maxItems.description: Shown when the array has more items than `maxItems`

customValidator.description: A custom validator that delegates validation to application code. The registered validator function receives these constraint keys and must return a Standard Schema V1-compliant schema object (https://standardschema.dev). Add arbitrary constraint keys alongside `type` - they are passed as-is to the registered validator function.

required.description: Makes the field mandatory - evaluation is still delegated to the custom validator

validator.description: Validation rules for this field. The `type` discriminant selects the validator: `string`, `number`, `integer`, `boolean`, `array`, or `custom`.
